removal.description: The agent removes itself from the machine: service, program and data folders, logs.

removal.uninstallAndDeleteText: Once the agent confirms the uninstall, the node and all of its data are deleted.
removal.offlineHint: If the agent does not confirm (machine offline or gone), the node can be deleted anyway after a waiting period.

removal.forceAllowed: The agent has not confirmed; the node can be deleted anyway.
removal.deleteText: The node and all of its data (inventory, events, job history) are deleted permanently.
removal.deleteAnywayText: The agent has not confirmed the uninstall. If it is still running, it will register the node again. The node and all of its data are deleted permanently.
removal.requested: Removal of {hostname} requested. The node disappears from the list once the agent has uninstalled itself.

onboarding.title: Add New Device
onboarding.description: Install the Octofleet agent on a Windows or Linux machine to start managing it.
onboarding.copyFailed: Could not copy – select the command and copy it by hand (show the API key first).
onboarding.done: Done – the agent installs, configures itself and starts reporting.
onboarding.appearsSoon: The device appears in the node list within about 30 seconds.

windows.step1: Open PowerShell as Administrator on the target machine.
windows.whatText: Loads the installer from this Octofleet server. The installer takes the latest agent release from this server (GitHub only if the server has none), verifies its SHA256 checksum, installs it as a Windows service and configures it with your server URL and API key.

linux.step1: Open a shell with sudo rights on the target machine.
linux.requirements: systemd-based distribution; missing tools (curl, jq) are installed with the system package manager.
linux.whatText: Loads the installer from this Octofleet server. The installer takes the agent and its systemd unit from this server and verifies their SHA256 checksums (GitHub only if the server has no Linux agent), installs the agent as the systemd service octofleet-agent and configures it with your server URL and API key. The node ID is the machine's hostname.
